title: Trojan War, the Bronze Age collapse and the Greek Dark Age

tellings.quote: You have the height of the Bronze Age, then you have the Troj, you know, you have the Trojan War, and then the Trojans war seems to coincide with the fall of the Bronze Age.

plain: The Trojan War seems to have happened at the very moment the Bronze Age world fell apart, the collapse of the great civilizations of the eastern Mediterranean that led into the Greek Dark Age. A researcher named Luke Caverns makes this connection on the show without naming a source, suggesting the old legend may remember a real catastrophe.
